Synopsis:
    The contractor behind the $14.7M Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool renovation admitted in documents that construction errors — insufficient primer application and chemically incompatible liner layers — caused the pool's coating to peel and blister. This contradicts the Trump administration's repeated claim that vandalism was the primary cause. The Justice Department had already signaled as much by dropping charges against former Olympian David Hearn in July, citing contractor fault. The White House and Interior Department continue to maintain a vandalism narrative while acknowledging repair obligations.
